> 第十章 浴火重生（第1页）
最先出现的就是冯斗头部，接下来就是他的四肢出现，慢慢地冯斗睁开双眼，然而此时的双眼发射出一股强光，根本就不是冯斗能够控制得了的。
冯斗此时根本就控制不住这一股力量，不由得发出一阵阵的叫声。
不知道过了多久，冯斗的眼睛终于恢复了正常，他的眼睛此时是火红色的，他慢慢地恢复了自己的意识，此时的他已经感受到自己的身体开始了变化！
他的修为由之前的灵动三段直接突破到了灵动七段，隐隐地有突破到灵动八段的征兆，单纯这样的一粒冬灵丹居然能够帮助他突破了四个级。
能够连跳四级，这一点真的是非常之惊喜的，冯斗发觉除了修为之后，他的精神力也有巨大的提升，现在已经突破到三阶了。
这样他可以将精神力在四周三百米的范围之内，就连一丝丝的动静都没有放过的，那么怕丝毫的动静都难逃过他的精神力所察觉的。
可他现在还没有真正地了解到精神力方面的知识，他现在的情况在精神力方面就被称为精神壁，一旦能够形成精神力，就会出现精神壁，一旦出现精神壁，他就可以成为精神力灵修者。
然而真正能够做到灵修和武修双修的人不是少数，但是一般人都能够同时将双修达到高级的却不是多见的。
冯斗却不知道自己已经走进一条艰辛而痛苦的道路，他此时发现了一件事那就是自己浴火重生之后，全身都是光秃秃的，就连一根毛都没有的。
他发觉自己的衣服全部都没有了，可是现在完全暴露出外表的，他连忙从自己的空间戒里拿出一套衣服，连忙穿上，他一点也不习惯全身裸露的。
他穿好衣服之后，他此时的眼睛闪出一道精光，他的眼睛已经完全不一样啦！
他只是觉得自己只是因为修为强烈提升而导致的眼睛疲劳，但是他还没有察觉到自己的眼睛改变。
冯斗简单地整理之后，他重新开始自己的旅途，他现在觉得自己应该离开这里，他觉得他自己对于整个世界的了解实在太少了。
他觉得自己应该赶紧到有人的地方，只有这里才能够尽快了解这个世界的真实情况，这样就更加方便他以后寻找关于自己的身世，乃至找到自己的亲生父母。
冯斗此时突破了修为之后，他赶起路来，比以前不知道快上多少，以他现在的修为，每秒的速度足可以达到57米。
他连忙赶路都已经到一座小城池，此时城池的名殿上写着“尧城”。
此时正值下午三点左右，大量的人都在街上走动，然而此时有不少人都交易，慢慢地冯斗就已经发现了这个城池除了可以用金币交易之后，还可以物物交换的。
换言之一句话，只有你能够出得起钱，除了修为不能够买的，其他的任何都可以的。他在空间戒拿出几样药材，在小贩那里换来三千多金币。
此时他不断在其他地方看，他希望能够找到合适自己的东西，突然之间他看到一个小贩的摊档上有一根非常之黝黑的棍子，他第一眼看到这一根棍子时，他觉得有一股归属感，他觉得这件事好像与他有着一丝丝的熟悉感。
他连忙说：“老板，这根棍子怎么样卖呢？”
那个摊主听到冯斗的话，他看了一眼那根棍子，他有点不耐烦地说：“就那根棍子只需要一千金币。”
“一千金币也太贵啦！能不能优惠点呢？八百，可以吗？”
当那个摊主听到这句话时，更加不耐烦，他说：“拿走吧！”

The latest chapter of the Fight between Immortal Souls_Chapter 10: Rebirth from the Fire Page 1_The Fight between Immortal Souls and Gongsun Murong Lan_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 10 Rebirth from the Fire (Page 1)
The first thing that appeared was Feng Dou's head, and then his limbs appeared. Slowly, Feng Dou opened his eyes, but at this time, his eyes emitted a strong light that was beyond Feng Dou's control.
Feng Dou couldn't control this force at this time, and couldn't help but let out bursts of screams.
I don't know how long it took, but Feng Dou's eyes finally returned to normal. His eyes were fiery red at this time. He slowly regained consciousness. At this time, he could feel his body beginning to change!
His cultivation level has directly broken through from the previous third level to the seventh level, and there are faint signs of breaking through to the eighth level. A single winter spirit pill like this can actually help him break through the fourth level.
It was really surprising to be able to jump four levels in a row. Feng Dou found that in addition to his cultivation, his mental power had also improved tremendously, and he had now broken through to the third level.
In this way, he can use his mental power within a range of three hundred meters in all directions, and not even let go of the slightest movement, so he is afraid that even the slightest movement will not escape the detection of his mental power.
But he hasn't really learned about spiritual power yet. His current situation is called a spiritual wall in terms of spiritual power. Once spiritual power can be formed, a spiritual wall will appear. Once a spiritual wall appears, he can become a spiritual practitioner.
However, there are not a few people who can truly achieve both spiritual and martial arts cultivation, but it is not uncommon for ordinary people to be able to achieve both advanced cultivation at the same time.
Feng Dou didn't know that he had entered a difficult and painful road. At this time, he discovered one thing: after he was reborn from the ashes, his whole body was bare, without even a hair.
He found that all his clothes were gone, but now his appearance was completely exposed. He quickly took out a set of clothes from his space ring and put them on quickly. He was not used to being naked at all.
After he put on his clothes, his eyes flashed with light. His eyes were completely different!
He just felt that his eyes were tired due to the strong improvement in cultivation, but he had not noticed the change in his eyes.
After Feng Dou simply sorted it out, he started his journey again. He now felt that he should leave here. He felt that he knew too little about the entire world.
He felt that he should hurry to a place with people. Only here could he understand the true situation of the world as soon as possible. This would make it easier for him to search for his life experience and even find his biological parents in the future.
After Feng Dou broke through his cultivation level at this time, he hurried forward, much faster than before. With his current cultivation level, his speed could reach 57 meters per second.
He hurriedly arrived at a small city. At this time, the name of the city's palace was written "Yao City".
It was around three o'clock in the afternoon, and a large number of people were walking on the street. However, many people were trading at this time. Slowly, Feng Dou discovered that in addition to trading with gold coins, this city could also be used for barter.
In other words, only you can afford it. Except for things that cannot be bought due to your cultivation level, anything else is acceptable. He took out a few medicinal materials in the space ring and exchanged them for more than three thousand gold coins from the vendor.
At this time, he kept looking in other places, hoping to find something suitable for him. Suddenly he saw a very dark stick on a hawker's stall. When he saw this stick for the first time, he felt a sense of belonging. He felt that this thing seemed to have a slight sense of familiarity with him.
He quickly said: "Boss, how do you sell this stick?"
When the stall owner heard Feng Dou's words, he glanced at the stick and said a little impatiently: "That stick only costs one thousand gold coins."
"One thousand gold coins is too expensive! Can we get a discount? Eight hundred, is that okay?"
When the stall owner heard this, he became even more impatient and said, "Take it away!"
